questions.question: Which span name represents an agent run in the GenAI conventions?
options: agent.start, emitted once when create_agent constructs the agent instance
run_chain, the span name emitted by the model/client category for raw LLM calls
agent_loop, the span name used for tool spans linked by parent-child relation
invoke_agent, optionally suffixed by gen_ai.agent.name when the agent is named
questions.explanation: invoke_agent is the canonical name; the agent's name attribute appears in the span name when set.

questions.question: Which three span categories does the GenAI SIG define?
options: Model/client, agent, and tool spans
Frontend, backend, and database spans
Read, write, and execute spans
Latency, error, and throughput spans
questions.explanation: Model/client (LLM calls), agent (create/invoke), tool (per invocation) are the categories.

questions.question: When does an invoke_agent span use kind CLIENT vs INTERNAL?
options: Always INTERNAL, because span kind is fixed by the SIG regardless of whether the service is remote or in-process
CLIENT for remote agent services (OpenAI Assistants, Bedrock Agents); INTERNAL for in-process frameworks (LangChain, CrewAI, local ReAct)
CLIENT only when the transport is HTTPS, and INTERNAL whenever the connection falls back to plain HTTP without TLS
Always CLIENT, since every invoke_agent span represents a network call to a model provider's API endpoint directly
questions.explanation: Remote agent calls are CLIENT; in-process agent runs are INTERNAL.

questions.question: What is the default rule for content capture (inputs and outputs)?
options: Capture everything by default so ops teams have full request and response bodies for every span
Capture only output text by default, while input prompts stay redacted unless requested
Instrumentations SHOULD NOT capture by default; capture is opt-in via gen_ai.* attributes
Capture only on error spans by default, skipping successful calls to reduce storage costs
questions.explanation: Default-off content capture protects PII and secrets; opt-in is explicit.

questions.question: Which attribute identifies the corpus or store consulted for a retrieval?
options: gen_ai.response.model
gen_ai.operation.name
gen_ai.provider.name
gen_ai.data_source.id
questions.explanation: gen_ai.data_source.id labels the RAG corpus or store hit by retrieval.

questions.question: What does the lesson recommend for storing prompt content in production?
options: Store content externally (S3, log store) and record reference IDs on the span instead
Capture full prompts on every span as plain text so ops can read exact requests directly
Never store any content at all, even as external references, to avoid legal discovery
Encrypt prompts directly inside span attributes using a key managed by the collector
questions.explanation: External storage with pointer IDs avoids PII leaking into traces that ops can read.
